reopen_rule: Reopen only when the evaluated package or executable version, the aligned benchmark semantics, or correctness evidence changes.

classification.T: Complete aligned callable implementation for the applicable graph contract.
classification.P: Callable implementation with a documented graph, parameter, numerical, or result restriction.
classification.F: No complete aligned implementation, forbidden fallback, or an incorrect implementation requiring an algorithm rewrite.
classification.timeout: A performance outcome that does not change T/P/F support.

restrictions.Efficiency: NetworkX efficiency is shortest-path efficiency, not Burt structural-hole efficiency.
restrictions.Hierarchy: NetworkX flow_hierarchy is not Burt structural-hole hierarchy.

restrictions.BellmanFord: The native CPU extension exposes no Bellman-Ford binding.
restrictions.EffectiveSize: Directed zero-outdegree vertices use a finite-versus-NaN convention different from the aligned reference.
restrictions.Efficiency: Directed undefined vertices use a finite-versus-NaN convention different from the aligned reference.
restrictions.Constraint: Directed zero-outdegree vertices use a finite-versus-NaN convention different from the aligned reference.

restrictions.Closeness: Requires explicit OUT direction and reachable-fraction correction on disconnected directed graphs.
restrictions.Constraint: Directed zero-outdegree output convention differs from the aligned reference.

restrictions.MST: No strict NetworkX backend implementation; direct cuGraph substitution is forbidden.
restrictions.SCC: No aligned strict backend implementation for directed SCC.
restrictions.BellmanFord: Version 26.2 forwards to Dijkstra and rejects negative weights.
restrictions.BC: Ordinary all-source BC is implemented, but betweenness_centrality_subset for BC-16 is not.
restrictions.Closeness: Not implemented by the strict backend.
restrictions.EffectiveSize: Not implemented by the strict backend.
restrictions.Efficiency: Not implemented by the strict backend.
restrictions.Constraint: Not implemented by the strict backend.
restrictions.Hierarchy: Not implemented by the strict backend.

restrictions.MST: Connected-input and input-type restrictions do not provide the common minimum spanning forest contract.
restrictions.LCC: Only the legacy executable is usable and it requires a disclosed normalization correctness repair.
restrictions.WCC: The maintained release has no aligned executable; the obsolete CC port is not substituted.
restrictions.BellmanFord: The weighted SSSP alias covers only nonnegative weights.
restrictions.BC: Upstream BC exists, but the evaluated CLI/result scaling does not reproduce the aligned directed BC-16 vector.

restrictions.BFS: The compiled example returns only source vertices instead of the reachable distance result.
restrictions.SSSP: The compiled example terminates with SIGSEGV.
restrictions.BC: The compiled example returns an all-zero vector on a graph with nonzero reference BC.
restrictions.WCC: The available CC path is incomplete and exposes no validated complete result.
restrictions.default: No validated complete implementation for the aligned public function; primitive availability is not counted as support.

restrictions.BC: The archived kernel requires a disclosed correctness-only initialization and dependency-level synchronization repair.
restrictions.default: The archived evaluation artifact implements only BC, SSSP, and KCore.
